title: Review primary and accent color design against Android color guidance
scope: Backlog item only. Review the primary/accent color design, not the app's overall interaction or layout design. Analysis and recommendations are deferred until explicitly requested; this task does not authorize implementation changes.
request: Analyze QShopper's selected primary and accent coloring design and compare it with Android design principles. The user clarified that the requested comparison concerns accent and primary colors specifically.
expected: An evidence-based assessment of the roles, selection, derivation, and application of primary and accent colors, identifying useful alignment with Android guidance and specific improvements where warranted.
review_topics: Which UI surfaces, controls, states, and text currently use primary and accent colors, and whether those roles are coherent.
How Theme.qml derives color shades and foreground/background combinations, including special palette handling.
Whether selected colors remain readable and distinguishable in Light, Dark, and System themes, including checked/inverse-theme states and translucent backgrounds.
How the color pickers represent the selected primary and accent colors and whether those selections produce predictable results throughout the app.
How Qt Quick Controls Material's primary/accent concepts map to the relevant Android/Material color roles; distinguish the APIs' naming and capabilities rather than assuming a one-to-one mapping.
Contrast, state feedback, and whether information depends on color alone within the primary/accent treatment.
implementation_notes: Use current official Android and Material color guidance when performing the review, with direct sources and the guidance version/date recorded.
Inspect actual rendered combinations as well as color helper functions. A nominal palette choice alone does not establish readable contrast after opacity and background composition.
Respect DESIGN.md's deliberate opacity, animation, and checked-state distinctions while evaluating color choices.
Separate Android recommendations, intentional QShopper choices, Qt style constraints, and actual implementation defects.
Avoid expanding this into an unsolicited full-app redesign or automatic Material-version migration.
Record proposed changes as separate actionable backlog items, linking existing issues instead of duplicating them.
acceptance_criteria: Map the actual primary/accent usages and color derivation rules in the current app.
Compare those usages with directly cited official Android/Material color guidance.
Assess representative primary/accent combinations in Light, Dark, and System themes, with readability and state feedback considered.
Report clear findings and justified recommendations, including what should stay as designed.
Capture recommended fixes separately in the backlog; make no theme or UI implementation changes as part of this review alone.
evidence: User backlog request and clarification on 2026-10-28: the comparison is specifically about accent and primary coloring.
